limits: This is a finite prior-record correction, not whole Pi or HTML template text closure.

Current HTML header reads the current agent state, not a prompt reconstructed separately for every exported historical branch. Existing recorded content can survive until replaced/deleted by section replay.

forceSystemPrompt request projection does not persist forced text. CustomPrompt truthiness and truthy sections.tools/rules overrides suppress native snippets/guidelines; transient settings alone do not prove recorded export presence.

Nested parameters are serialized as data but not recursively painted by the native viewer. OutputSchema is absent from the direct export metadata map; generated custom/codemode descriptions remain pending.
Settings/model configuration schemas are not AgentTool parameters. No native export promotion without lineage.
Supplementary pi-agent-core/pi-ai snapshots prove exact versions/two-tree bytes only; their canonical archives are outside the two supplied archive authorities.
